newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines starts 3.07 bln peso airport project.
newsitem.headline: Philippines starts 3.07 bln peso airport project.

text.p: Philippine president Fidel Ramos said on Monday the Philippines has begun upgrading its international airport in Davao, in the southern island of Mindanao at a cost of 3.07 billion pesos.
He told reporters the project which take two and a half years and allow the airport to handle 1.1 million passengers a year.
Department of Transportation sources said the project would involve extending the airport's runway by 500 metres to 3,000 metres and construction of a new termnial building.
The sources said the civil works portion of the project will be awarded by the end of the month.
The project is financed in part by the Asian Development Bank and the European Investment Bank. The Davao airport is one of five international airports in the country.
